Class SigmaStartupListener

java.lang.Object
com.articulate.sigma.SigmaStartupListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventListener, javax.servlet.ServletContextListener
public class SigmaStartupListener extends Object implements javax.servlet.ServletContextListener
Listens for server startup and automatically runs SigmaKEE initialization, starting with KBmanager.initializeOnce().

Shaun Rose
